in_arabic.name: Nardeen
in_arabic.long_meaning: Nardeen هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic root 'nur' meaning 'light'. Nardeen symbolizes radiance and illumination. In Islamic tradition, it is believed that the light of Allah guides and protects the believers.
